subject: CTO briefing: MAP governance, decision owners & close timeline
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Lara Jennings <lara.jennings@clearskyhealth.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@clearskyhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: CTO briefing: MAP governance, decision owners & close timeline

Hi Lara / Daniel —

Thanks again for taking time yesterday. Per our conversation I pulled together a short kickoff to get the MAP (mutual action plan) aligned with ClearSky’s governance and the exec-level outcomes you raised. I attached a working MAP spreadsheet (RDW_MAP_v1.0.xlsx) and a short infra brief.

Proposed objectives for the quarter:
- Proof-of-concept for secure PHI redaction in a live patient-sim flow (Q3 pilot)
- <20% token-cost delta vs your baseline with equivalent latency SLOs
- Clear escalation/resolution path for any model-quality regressions

What I need from your side this week:
1) Confirm executive sponsor and escalation owner (we heard Daniel and Tom as possible owners; please confirm)
2) Assign an internal evaluation lead and curator for the prompt/test set (name + email)
3) Approve the proposed close timeline below or suggest alternate dates

Proposed close timeline (high level):
- 6/12 — MAP kickoff + initial roles (this thread)
- 6/19 — Shared eval plan and data access checklist (your side provides test prompts)
- 7/10 — Pilot readiness review (vault/KMS and VPC config complete)
- 7/24 — Pilot start (2–4 week run; we’ll run automated evals)
- 8/14 — Pilot review & commercial terms finalization

Escalation & governance we propose (short):
- Day-to-day: ClearSky evaluation lead + Redwood AE/CSr
- Technical blocker (model/perf/regression): Redwood infra lead (Karthik) + ClearSky Eng owner
- Exec escalation: Daniel (CTO) ↔ Sean Gallagher (Head of Sales Ops) for any SLA/contract decisions

I’ll update the MAP spreadsheet with these fields; feel free to edit directly in the Drive link below.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_MAP

Thanks — I’ll follow up mid-week.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RDW_MAP_v1.0.xlsx (spreadsheet), Redwood-Product-21Q-infra-brief.pdf (pdf)

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@clearskyhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Lara Jennings <lara.jennings@clearskyhealth.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <t.reed@clearskyhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 15:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CTO briefing: MAP governance, decision owners & close timeline

Vanessa — thanks for the clear summary. Lara and I reviewed with Tom (procurement). A few quick answers: 
- Exec sponsor: Daniel Park (CTO) — I will own exec escalations.
- Escalation owner (procurement/legal): Tom Reed will own commercial intake and contract redlines.
- Evaluation lead: Lara Jennings will own the prompt set and clinical validation coordination (cc’d).

We like the proposed timeline, but two asks before we lock dates:
1) Can Redwood provide a short template for the evaluation rubric (what exact metrics you will run vs our baseline)?
2) We need an initial data flow diagram for the pilot (to share with security team) — minimal details, high level.

If you can drop both items by Friday 6/16, we’ll confirm the 7/10 pilot-readiness checkpoint.

—Daniel
Daniel Park
CTO, ClearSky Health
daniel.park@clearskyhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-2400

Daniel / Lara —

I’ll own the technical escalation path during the pilot. A couple of clarifying points I added to the MAP spreadsheet:
- Eval rubric template: I created a simple CSV schema in the Drive folder (metric, measurement_window, pass_threshold, owner). Vanessa — please review and push to the MAP.
- Data flow diagram: Priyom, Sean — we’ll need the one-pager to include a short note on tokenization boundaries and the KV cache policy for the pilot.

Daniel — you’ll see a brief note in the MAP about the fallback policy: if model variant A degrades >3% on NLU pass rate for two consecutive days we’ll automatically fallback to variant B and open the incident ticket. Exec escalation only if we can’t stabilize within 48 hours.

I’ll be on call for the 7/10 readiness review.

Thanks — Karthik
